Subject: martingales | ID: 67727

Statement

Consider the complex equation on a Frechet space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Step 3. By the rational spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the rational spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via complex interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01310011 \cdot C_01310012 \cdot C_01310013\).
